items.item:
1. A proven read-only flow asked for by an agent is active at once and records the
   kernel as actor.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a06_read_only_flow_activated_by_kernel]
statements:
```text
flow_activation -> proven(flow_version) at activation
highest_effect_class = read  -> activated_by = kernel
highest_effect_class > read  -> activated_by = owner
agent_asks(effectful) -> refused AND nothing_kept
new_flow_version -/> inherits(activation | grant | approval)
```

verdicts.why: The selected test detects that a proven read-only version requested by an agent becomes active immediately and records the kernel as actor. It does not establish that proof is performed at activation, nor test effectful-agent refusal with nothing kept, owner activation of effectful flows, or that new versions inherit no activation, grant, or approval.
